original.statement: The upgrade guide lists running Crossplane v1.20 as a prerequisite for upgrading to Crossplane v2.

decision.reason: [ev-924a17cf8cd5] lists "You're running Crossplane v1.20" under the Prerequisites of the v2 upgrade guide. That makes being on v1.20 a step an operator must complete before upgrading, so the migration family with migration-required fits. P2's alternative, compatibility-boundary name=crossplane, doesn't fit: that family is for a platform or managed operand, not the product's own upgrade path. The proposed name follows the evidence's own key words, though the exact wording of the step's name is my judgement call.
